skills.name: Subtract Like Denominators
skills.definition: Subtract fractions that have the same denominator.

skills.name: Subtract Unlike Denominators
skills.definition: Find a common denominator and subtract fractions with different denominators.

skills.name: Convert Mixed Numbers
skills.definition: Convert between mixed numbers and improper fractions, and handle mixed number notation.

skills.name: Borrowing in Mixed Subtraction
skills.definition: Regroup or borrow from the whole number when the fraction part of the subtrahend is larger.

skills.name: Simplify Fractions
skills.definition: Reduce fractions to their lowest terms.
